professors.name: Aurora Vintesang
professors.subject: Nordic geography & weather
professors.description: Frost, stars, storms, and landscapes turned into grand musical stories.

professors.name: Professor BeatConductor
professors.subject: HardStyle Science
professors.description: A tiny conductor with enormous energy. The lecture builds; the bass drops.

professors.name: Professor Bríd O’Quill
professors.subject: Oceanography & currents
professors.description: Tides, layers, and currents become salty stories with a folk-punk bite.

professors.name: Professor Chrisjen Avasarala
professors.subject: Governance & political ethics
professors.description: Power, responsibility, and very difficult questions. Bring an argument that can survive the eyebrow.

professors.name: Professor Derya Yıldırım
professors.subject: Geophysics & tectonic dynamics
professors.description: Continents move, faults slip, and a quiet lecture can become a seismic event.

professors.name: Professor G’Kar
professors.subject: Mythology & religious studies
professors.description: Memory, faith, resistance, and the difficult work of understanding one another.
professors.source: Char sheets/Professor G’Kar_ Narn Wisdom Archive.png

professors.name: Professor Garfunkel
professors.subject: Narrative composition & cinematic sound
professors.description: Small musical ideas become sweeping stories. Dramatic wings are part of the presentation.
professors.source: Char sheets/Professor Garfunkel_ The Felt Faculty Profile.png

professors.name: Professor GLaDOS
professors.subject: Experimental methodology & research ethics
professors.description: Careful experiments. Uncomfortable questions. A wonderfully unsettling classroom assistant.
professors.source: Char sheets/Muppet Science Academy_ Professor GLaDOS.png

professors.name: Puppet Professor Gowron
professors.subject: Maths, buoyancy & applied honor
professors.description: Sharing is a matter of honor. Physics remains unimpressed by shouting.
professors.source: Char sheets/Puppet Professor Gowron_ Honor Academy Poster.png

professors.name: Inara Talamasca
professors.subject: Curiosity, music & discovery
professors.description: The curious snow-leopard explorer who turns “what happens if…” into an adventure.

professors.name: Dr. Kiko Kisaragi
professors.subject: Volcanology & eruption science
professors.description: Polite, precise explanations meet a planet with absolutely no volume control.

professors.name: Professor D. Layman
professors.subject: Music theory & ear training
professors.description: Harmony, rhythm, counterpoint, and song structure made approachable. Listen first; the patterns follow.
professors.source: Char sheets/Professor Layman’s Music Theory Poster.png

professors.name: Lenthrea WarTigress
professors.subject: Musical performance & faculty adventures
professors.description: The teal tigress brings music, energy, and a formidable sense of adventure to the Academy.

professors.name: Professor Londo Mollari
professors.subject: Imperial history & catastrophic diplomacy
professors.description: Grand ambitions, dangerous bargains, and the bill that eventually arrives.

professors.name: Professor LSD.FM
professors.subject: Psychoacoustics & musical neuroscience
professors.description: Sound, perception, rhythm, and the curious ways we listen to music.

professors.name: Maestro Dr. Lucio Bellaforte
professors.subject: Acoustics & wave physics
professors.description: Resonance, harmonics, and vibration, conducted with spectacular operatic enthusiasm.

professors.name: Professor Mags MacLeod
professors.subject: Meteorology & storm systems
professors.description: Clouds, fronts, forecasts, and practical preparedness—with warmth enough for a blizzard.

professors.name: Professor Meera Raman
professors.subject: Mathematics & rhythmic logic
professors.description: Fractions, primes, symmetry, and patterns. Six arms make the counting look effortless.

professors.name: Professor Miles O’Brien
professors.subject: Engineering & emergency repair
professors.description: Keep the system running, explain why it broke, and try not to lose the last working tool.

professors.name: Professor Nezkith
professors.subject: Culinary chemistry
professors.description: Browning, flavour, and carefully controlled kitchen catastrophes. The quiet voice is the warning.

professors.name: Professor Pondscum
professors.subject: Decomposition & bog biology
professors.description: Rot, fungi, microbes, and nature’s recycling crew. Disgusting? He prefers “beautiful.”
professors.source: Char sheets/Professor Pondscum_ Rot Is Life.png

professors.name: Professor Rúna Rassafrass
professors.subject: Physics, astronomy & extremely important small things
professors.description: Real science delivered at an entirely unreasonable orchestral scale. But vait…

professors.name: Professor Vikingur
professors.subject: Progressive genre forging
professors.description: Riffs, cinematic arrangements, and bridges between musical worlds. Forge meaning into the noise.
professors.source: Char sheets/Vikingur_ Puppet Academy Professor Profile.png

professors.name: Puppet Professor Zalixor
professors.subject: Sound, frequency & fungal imagination
professors.description: The Sound Fungus explores resonance through a gloriously colourful world of musical experiments.
professors.source: Char sheets/Neon Puppet Professor Zalixor Character Sheet.png

professors.name: Professor Zilla
professors.subject: Tidal listening & forgotten melodies
professors.description: Listen closely to little sounds, found objects, and the stories a tide can leave behind.
professors.source: Char sheets/Felt Professor Zilla Academy Dossier (1).png

songs.title: The Great Matter Masquerade
songs.description: Solid, liquid, gas—and an outrageously theatrical journey through changing states.

songs.title: The Sideways Fall of Stars
songs.description: A cosmic lecture about falling sideways, orbiting worlds, and the pull of gravity.

songs.title: FUUU-SION!
songs.subtitle: Do Not Lick de Sun!
songs.description: Hydrogen, helium, and the extraordinary process that powers a star.

songs.title: STELLAR DEATH!
songs.subtitle: Not Every Star Goes Boom!
songs.description: Red giants, white dwarfs, and spectacular stellar endings—with an important reminder that not every star explodes.
alternate_sources: Song Covers/Stellar Death_ Rúna’s Cosmic Lecture.png

songs.title: Today Is a Good Day to Share!
songs.description: Twelve worms. Four bowls. An arithmetic lesson treated as a glorious matter of state.

songs.title: The Duck Has No Honor!
songs.description: A floating bath toy challenges a professor’s authority. The duck has physics on its side.

songs.title: Stop Multiplying, You Furry PetaQ!
songs.description: One gong, twice as many furry problems. Repeated doubling becomes a classroom emergency.

songs.title: Let the Sky Learn My Name
songs.description: A storm-dark harbour, a failed beacon, and a community finding its voice to guide boats home.
songs.source: Song Covers/Storm-Sung Fjord_ Let the Sky Learn My Name.png

songs.title: The Ice Wrote the Coast!
songs.description: Follow the landscape from river valleys to glacial carving and a sea-filled fjord.
songs.source: Song Covers/The Ice Wrote the Coast.png

songs.title: EVERYTHING ROTS!
songs.subtitle: And That’s a Beautiful Thing!
songs.description: A joyful swamp lesson about decay, fungi, microbes, and the life that grows from what breaks down.
songs.source: Song Covers/Professor Pondscum's Rotten Swamp Lecture.png

songs.title: Bend the Facts
songs.subtitle: Tell the Truth
songs.description: A lesson concept about how figurative language can bend literal description and still reveal emotional truth.
songs.source: Song Covers/Professor Amoyra Bends the Facts.png
